prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1225; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If you have a representative handling this claim, we ask that you share that person's contact information with us as well.

To allow us to evaluate the claim properly, we request a complete statement of the liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, including any applicable excess or umbrella coverage. Please also confirm in writing whether any other policies may respond to this loss.

We further ask that the insurer and its insured preserve all evidence relating to the incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, witness statements, recorded calls, repair estimates, and the damaged vehicles themselves. Routine deletion or disposal of any such material should be suspended immediately.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter within ten business days. We look forward to your prompt response.
